# heatham

## Overview

The temperaturepackage provides a dataset
containing daily maximum temperatures in Hamilton, Ontario 
and a function to retrieve the maximum temperature for a given date.

## Dataset

The package contains the dataset `temperature_data`,
which includes the date and maximum daily temperature.

## Function

The package includes the function
`get_max_temperature()`.

This function returns the maximum daily temperature
in Hamilton, ON for a specified date.

If no temperature is available, an informative
message is returned.

## Example

```r
library(heatham)

get_max_temperature("2024-07-15")
```
